quests.instruction: The sun is just coming up and the birds are starting to sing. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Think about the part of the day when a new day begins.
quests.explanation: The sun rising and birds waking up tell us that a new day is starting. That part of the day is called morning.
quests.funFact: A day is often split into four parts: morning, afternoon, evening and night.

quests.instruction: Which of these is a part of the day?
quests.hint: A part of the day is much shorter than a whole day.
quests.explanation: Afternoon is one part of a single day. Tuesday is a whole day, and winter is a season that lasts for months.
quests.funFact: Earth spins around once about every 24 hours, and this spin gives us day and night.

quests.instruction: Stars twinkle and the moon glows in a dark sky. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Think about when the sky is dark enough to see stars.
quests.explanation: Stars and the moon are easiest to see when the sky is dark. That is the night.
quests.funFact: The Moon does not make its own light. It shines because it reflects sunlight.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day comes right after morning?
quests.hint: Say the parts of the day in order, starting with morning.
quests.explanation: The day goes morning, afternoon, evening, night. Afternoon comes right after morning.
quests.funFact: The word afternoon means "after noon", the time after the middle of the day.

quests.instruction: The sun is sinking low and the sky is turning orange and pink. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Is the sun climbing higher or sinking lower?
quests.explanation: A sinking sun means the day is ending. The part of the day when the sun sets is the evening.
quests.funFact: At sunset, sunlight travels through more air to reach our eyes, which is why the sky often looks orange and pink.

quests.instruction: Which part of the day comes just before morning?
quests.hint: The parts of the day repeat in a circle. What comes right before morning starts again?
quests.explanation: After the night, a new morning begins. The day goes around in a circle: morning, afternoon, evening, night, then morning again.
quests.funFact: Each new day officially starts at midnight, in the middle of the night, not at sunrise.

quests.instruction: Which activity fits the morning best?
quests.hint: In the morning, the sun is just beginning its trip across the sky.
quests.explanation: The sun rises when a new day begins, so watching it rise fits the morning. The sun sets at the end of the day.
quests.funFact: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

quests.instruction: Rafi has finished lunch and goes out to play in the warm, bright sun. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: Lunch is eaten in the middle of the day. What part of the day comes after the middle?
quests.explanation: Rafi plays after lunch, while the sun is still high and bright. That part of the day is the afternoon.
quests.funFact: Shadows are shortest when the sun is highest, near the middle of the day, and longer early and late in the day.

quests.instruction: What happens to the light outside as evening turns into night?
quests.hint: Think about what happens after the sun has set.
quests.explanation: Once the sun has set, less and less daylight is left, so the sky gets darker until it is night.
quests.funFact: Many streetlights have sensors that switch them on when daylight fades.

quests.instruction: Which tool tells you what time it is right now?
quests.hint: You need something that shows hours, not days.
quests.explanation: A clock shows the time of day. A calendar shows days and dates, and a ruler measures length.
quests.funFact: Long ago, people used sundials, which tell the time by where a shadow falls.

quests.instruction: A round clock face has numbers around its edge. What is the biggest number on it?
quests.hint: Look at the very top of a clock.
quests.explanation: A clock face shows the numbers 1 to 12. The 12 sits at the top and is the biggest.
quests.funFact: Many ancient peoples divided the daytime into 12 parts, which is one reason clocks show 12 numbers.

quests.instruction: Which clock shows time with numbers like 7:00 and has no moving hands?
quests.hint: Look for the clock that writes the time with digits.
quests.explanation: A digital clock shows the time in numbers, such as 7:00. A clock with hands is called an analog clock, and a sand timer only measures how long something lasts.
quests.funFact: A sand timer measures a set length of time, such as one minute, instead of telling the time of day.

quests.instruction: On a clock, the short hand is called the ___ hand.
quests.hint: The short hand moves very slowly and takes a long time to go all the way round.
quests.explanation: The short hand shows the hour. It is the slowest hand and moves just a little at a time.
quests.funFact: Clocks turn "clockwise" because shadows on early sundials moved that way in the Northern Hemisphere.

quests.instruction: Which hand moves around the clock faster?
options: They move at the same speed
quests.hint: One hand needs far more time than the other to go all the way round.
quests.explanation: The long minute hand goes all the way round in one hour. The short hour hand needs 12 hours, so it is much slower.
quests.funFact: A second hand, when a clock has one, is the fastest of all. It goes around once every minute.

quests.instruction: How long does the long hand take to go all the way around the clock once?
quests.hint: Look at where the long hand is at 3:00, and then where it is at 4:00.
quests.explanation: The long minute hand makes one full turn in 60 minutes, which is exactly 1 hour.
quests.funFact: The hour hand makes two full turns each day: one for the morning half and one for the afternoon half.

quests.instruction: The long hand points to 12 and the short hand points to 4. What time is it?
quests.hint: The short hand tells you the hour.
quests.explanation: When the long hand is on 12, it is an o'clock time. The short hand is on 4, so it is 4 o'clock.
quests.funFact: O'clock is short for "of the clock".

quests.instruction: It is 7 o'clock. Where is the long hand?
quests.hint: At every o'clock time, the long hand is in the same place.
quests.explanation: At o'clock times, the long minute hand points straight up at 12. The short hand shows the hour.
quests.funFact: The 12 at the top of the clock is where the minute hand starts every new hour.

quests.instruction: Which clock shows 6 o'clock?
quests.correctAnswer: Long hand on 12, short hand on 6
options: Long hand on 12, short hand on 6
Long hand on 6, short hand on 12
quests.hint: First decide which hand must point straight up for an o'clock time.
quests.explanation: For 6 o'clock, the long hand points straight up to 12 and the short hand points to 6. Swapping the hands would show a different time.
quests.funFact: At 6 o'clock the two hands make a straight line, one pointing up and one pointing down.

quests.instruction: The toy clock face 🕗 shows a whole hour. What time is it?
quests.hint: Find the short hand first. Which number does it point to?
quests.explanation: The long hand is on 12 and the short hand is on 8, so the time is 8:00.
quests.funFact: In a digital time, the hour comes first, then a colon, then the minutes. At o'clock times the minutes are 00.

quests.instruction: A digital clock shows 5:00. How do we say this time?
quests.hint: The number before the colon is the hour.
quests.explanation: The 5 before the colon is the hour, and 00 means no extra minutes. So it is 5 o'clock.
quests.funFact: The two dots in a digital time are called a colon. They separate the hours from the minutes.

quests.instruction: A film starts at 3 o'clock. Which digital time shows this?
quests.hint: A digital time shows the hour first, then the minutes.
quests.explanation: The hour goes before the colon. 3:00 means 3 hours and 0 minutes, so it is 3 o'clock. 12:03 has the hour 12, and 3:30 is half an hour after 3 o'clock.
quests.funFact: Writing 3:00 is a short way to say 3 hours and 0 minutes.

quests.instruction: Which is a sensible time for a child to be fast asleep?
quests.hint: Think about when the sky is dark and most people are resting.
quests.explanation: At 11 o'clock at night it is dark and quiet, so sleeping fits. At 11 in the morning and 2 in the afternoon it is daytime.
quests.funFact: Many children aged 6 to 12 need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep each night.

quests.instruction: How many times does a clock show 8 o'clock in one whole day?
quests.hint: Imagine the whole day from one midnight to the next. How often does the hour hand reach the 8?
quests.explanation: A day has 24 hours, but a clock shows only 12 numbers. So each hour, such as 8 o'clock, happens twice: once before noon and once after noon.
quests.funFact: Because a day has 24 hours, the hour hand goes around the clock twice each day.

quests.instruction: Kofi's clock says 7 o'clock just as the sun is rising. What kind of 7 o'clock is it?
quests.hint: Is the sun coming up or going down?
quests.explanation: The sun rises in the morning, so this is 7 o'clock in the morning. The same hour on the clock comes again later in the day.
quests.funFact: Close to the equator, the sun rises and sets at nearly the same times all year, around 6 o'clock.

quests.instruction: AM means times from midnight until noon. PM means times from noon until midnight. Which of these times is in the afternoon?
quests.hint: Afternoon comes after the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: Afternoon is after noon, so it uses PM. 3:00 AM is in the middle of the night, and 9:00 AM is in the morning.
quests.funFact: AM and PM come from Latin: ante meridiem means "before midday", and post meridiem means "after midday".

quests.instruction: A clock shows 7:00 AM. Which part of the day is it?
quests.hint: AM times come before the middle of the day.
quests.explanation: 7:00 AM is before noon, so it is in the morning. The same 7 on the clock in the evening would be written 7:00 PM.
quests.funFact: Some countries use a 24-hour clock, where 3:00 PM is written as 15:00.

quests.instruction: Noon is the middle of the day. At which time is the sun highest in the sky?
quests.hint: Noon is the moment when the morning ends and the afternoon begins.
quests.explanation: Noon, when the sun is highest, is written 12:00 PM. 12:00 AM is midnight, in the middle of the night, and 6:00 AM is around sunrise.
quests.funFact: Midnight is when the date changes, so 12:00 AM is the very first moment of a new day.

quests.instruction: A rooster crows as the sun rises. Which time fits best?
quests.hint: Decide the part of the day first, then think about whether AM or PM fits it.
quests.explanation: Sunrise is the start of the morning, so AM fits. 6:00 PM is evening, and 12:00 AM is midnight, when it is dark.
quests.funFact: Roosters often crow before sunrise because their body clocks tell them morning is near.

quests.instruction: A family lies on the grass and looks at the stars. Which time fits best?
quests.hint: Stars only show up when the sky is dark. Is that more likely AM or PM?
quests.explanation: Stars can be seen when it is dark, and 9:00 PM is night. At 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM the sun is up.
quests.funFact: Stars are still in the sky during the day. The sun's bright light just hides them.

quests.instruction: Two of these times are at night. Which one is NOT at night?
quests.hint: Check AM or PM first, then picture the sky at that time.
quests.explanation: 11:00 PM and 2:00 AM are both in the dark of night. 1:00 PM is just after noon, in the bright afternoon.
quests.funFact: A full day has 24 hours: 12 hours from midnight to noon are AM, and 12 hours from noon to midnight are PM.
